name: Benazir Kafaalat - quarterly cash stipend
name_ur: بینظیر کفالت - سہ ماہی نقد وظیفہ
target_group: Women from low-income households registered in the national poverty survey
summary_en: Pakistan's largest social protection programme: an unconditional quarterly cash stipend paid directly to the woman of a low-income household. Eligibility is decided by a poverty score calculated from the national survey, not by a paperwork application - so the real first step is finding out whether your household is already registered and what score it holds.
summary_ur: پاکستان کا سب سے بڑا سماجی تحفظ کا پروگرام: کم آمدنی والے گھرانے کی خاتون کو براہِ راست ادا کیا جانے والا سہ ماہی غیر مشروط نقد وظیفہ۔ اہلیت کا فیصلہ قومی سروے سے نکالے گئے غربت اسکور سے ہوتا ہے، کاغذی درخواست سے نہیں - اس لیے پہلا اصل قدم یہ معلوم کرنا ہے کہ آپ کا گھرانہ رجسٹرڈ ہے یا نہیں اور اس کا اسکور کیا ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: The actual eligibility test is the PMT (Proxy Means Test) poverty score produced by the National Socio-Economic Registry survey, which weighs household assets, housing and family size - not a monthly income figure. The income condition shown here is our approximation so that this screening can say something useful; it is not the programme's own rule. Send your CNIC number to 8171 to get your household's real status. Households with a member who has a disability, and transgender persons, are covered under specific provisions.

required_documents: Valid CNIC of the woman receiving the payment
B-Form (Child Registration Certificate) for children in the household
Registration in the National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER) survey
Mobile number registered in your own name, for the 8171 service
application_steps: Send your CNIC number in an SMS to 8171 to check whether your household is registered and eligible
If you are not registered, visit your nearest BISP Tehsil Office and ask to be surveyed for the NSER
Complete the dynamic survey - this is what produces your poverty score
Check your status again on 8171 or at the tehsil office once the survey is processed
Collect payments from a designated BISP payment campsite or authorised retailer when a quarter is disbursed
disclaimer: Eligibility is determined by BISP's PMT poverty score, which this screening cannot calculate - a result here is an indication of whether it is worth checking, never a decision. Confirm your household's actual status by sending your CNIC to 8171.

name: Benazir Taleemi Wazaif - education stipend for children
name_ur: بینظیر تعلیمی وظائف - بچوں کے لیے تعلیمی وظیفہ
target_group: School-going children from households already receiving Benazir Kafaalat
summary_en: A quarterly education stipend paid on top of Kafaalat for each child of the household who is enrolled and attending school, from primary through higher secondary. The stipend is deliberately higher for girls than for boys. Attendance of at least 70 percent is what keeps the payment coming, so this is conditional in a way most assistance is not.
summary_ur: کفالت کے علاوہ ادا کیا جانے والا سہ ماہی تعلیمی وظیفہ، گھرانے کے ہر اس بچے کے لیے جو اسکول میں داخل ہو اور حاضری دے رہا ہو - پرائمری سے ہائر سیکنڈری تک۔ لڑکیوں کا وظیفہ جان بوجھ کر لڑکوں سے زیادہ رکھا گیا ہے۔ ادائیگی جاری رہنے کے لیے کم از کم 70 فیصد حاضری لازمی ہے، اس لیے یہ زیادہ تر امداد کے برعکس مشروط ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: The household must already be a Benazir Kafaalat beneficiary - this stipend is an addition to that, not a separate programme you can join on its own. The real age range starts at 4 years for primary school; this record starts at 14 because that is the youngest age this screening tool accepts. Girls receive a higher stipend than boys at every level, and at least 70 percent school attendance must be maintained each quarter.

required_documents: B-Form or CNIC of the enrolled child
CNIC of the mother, who must be a Kafaalat beneficiary
School enrolment certificate from a recognised institution
Quarterly attendance record signed by the school
application_steps: Confirm the household is receiving Benazir Kafaalat - this stipend is built on top of it
Enrol the child in a recognised school if they are not already attending
Register the child at a BISP Tehsil Office with the B-Form and the school's enrolment certificate
Have the school record and certify attendance each quarter
Collect the stipend alongside the Kafaalat payment once compliance is confirmed
source_title: BISP - Benazir Taleemi Wazaif programme page
disclaimer: This stipend is only available to households already enrolled in Benazir Kafaalat, which this screening cannot check for you. Stipend amounts differ by school level and by the child's gender, and are revised periodically.

name: Benazir Nashonuma - nutrition support for mothers and infants
name_ur: بینظیر نشوونما - ماؤں اور شیرخوار بچوں کے لیے غذائی معاونت
target_group: Pregnant and breastfeeding women, and children under two, in low-income households
summary_en: Conditional cash plus specialised nutritious food, aimed squarely at stunting in the first thousand days of a child's life. It is for pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, and children under two - payments are tied to attending antenatal check-ups, immunisation and nutrition-awareness sessions at a Nashonuma facility.
summary_ur: مشروط نقد رقم کے ساتھ خصوصی غذائی خوراک، جس کا براہِ راست ہدف بچے کی زندگی کے پہلے ہزار دنوں میں نشوونما کی کمی ہے۔ یہ حاملہ خواتین، دودھ پلانے والی ماؤں اور دو سال سے کم عمر بچوں کے لیے ہے - ادائیگیاں نشوونما مرکز پر حمل کے معائنے، حفاظتی ٹیکوں اور غذائی آگاہی کے سیشنز میں شرکت سے مشروط ہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: The real condition is being pregnant or breastfeeding, or having a child under two years old - none of which this screening asks about, because a profile here holds no health information. The age range shown is simply the usual childbearing range and is a poor substitute. Read the summary and decide for yourself whether this applies to you: a green result here means only that nothing in your profile rules it out.

required_documents: Valid CNIC of the mother
Pregnancy confirmation or the child's B-Form, depending on which applies
Registration in the National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER)
Immunisation card for the child, once enrolled
application_steps: Find your nearest Benazir Nashonuma facility - they are attached to selected district and tehsil health facilities
Register at the facility with your CNIC while pregnant, or with the child's B-Form if the child is under two
Attend the scheduled antenatal or child health check-ups
Collect the specialised nutritious food supplied at each visit
Receive the conditional cash payment each quarter, subject to attendance
disclaimer: The deciding condition for this programme is pregnancy, breastfeeding, or having a child under two - a health circumstance this screening deliberately does not ask about. Treat any result here as a prompt to read the summary, not as an eligibility decision. Nashonuma facilities do not yet cover every district.

name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal - Individual Financial Assistance
name_ur: پاکستان بیت المال - انفرادی مالی امداد
target_group: Destitute individuals needing one-off help with medical treatment, education or a household crisis
summary_en: A one-off grant rather than a recurring stipend, for a specific need you can document: hospital treatment, a child's school or university fees, or rehabilitation after a crisis. Applications are made at a Bait-ul-Mal district office and assessed case by case, which means a strong, well-documented case matters more here than it does in a score-based programme.
summary_ur: یہ مستقل وظیفہ نہیں بلکہ ایک بار ملنے والی گرانٹ ہے، کسی مخصوص اور دستاویزی ضرورت کے لیے: ہسپتال کا علاج، بچے کی اسکول یا یونیورسٹی فیس، یا کسی بحران کے بعد بحالی۔ درخواست بیت المال کے ضلعی دفتر میں دی جاتی ہے اور ہر کیس کا الگ جائزہ لیا جاتا ہے، اس لیے یہاں اچھی طرح دستاویزی درخواست اسکور پر مبنی پروگراموں کی نسبت زیادہ اہم ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Widows, orphans, persons with disabilities and the chronically ill are given preference, and a widow's case carries particular weight - but the programme is open to any destitute applicant who can document the need. Marital status is not something this screening asks about, so a widow's advantage will not appear in the result; mention it in the application. Grants are paid against a documented expense, often directly to the hospital or institution rather than in cash.

required_documents: CNIC of the applicant
Income certificate or an affidavit of financial condition
Hospital estimate and doctor's diagnosis, for medical assistance
Fee voucher and enrolment proof, for education assistance
Death certificate of the spouse, for a widow's application
Disability certificate, if applying on that basis
application_steps: Locate your Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal district office
Collect the Individual Financial Assistance application form
Gather documentation of the specific need - an estimate, a fee voucher, a diagnosis
Submit the completed form with your CNIC and proof of financial condition
Attend the assessment interview if you are called for one
Follow up at the district office; payment is often released directly to the hospital or institution
disclaimer: Assistance is assessed case by case against available funds, so meeting the conditions does not guarantee a grant. The amount depends entirely on the documented need. Confirm current arrangements at your district Bait-ul-Mal office.

name: Pakistan Sweet Homes - residential care and schooling for orphans
name_ur: پاکستان سویٹ ہومز - یتیم بچوں کے لیے رہائش اور تعلیم
target_group: Orphaned children needing full residential care, schooling and upkeep
summary_en: Full residential care for orphaned children - accommodation, food, clothing, healthcare and schooling, at no cost to the family. Homes operate in districts across the country and children stay through their education. This is not a cash programme: it is a place to live and a school to attend.
summary_ur: یتیم بچوں کے لیے مکمل رہائشی کفالت - رہائش، خوراک، لباس، علاج اور تعلیم، خاندان پر کوئی خرچ نہیں۔ یہ ہومز ملک بھر کے اضلاع میں کام کرتے ہیں اور بچے اپنی تعلیم مکمل ہونے تک وہاں رہتے ہیں۔ یہ نقد امداد کا پروگرام نہیں: یہ رہنے کی جگہ اور پڑھنے کا ادارہ ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Admission normally starts at age 4; this record begins at 14 because that is the youngest age this screening tool accepts, so younger children are not excluded in reality - apply on their behalf directly. Children who have lost their father are accepted, not only those who have lost both parents. Places depend on capacity at the home nearest you.

required_documents: Death certificate of the deceased parent
B-Form of the child
CNIC of the surviving parent or guardian
Affidavit of the family's financial condition
Recent photographs of the child
application_steps: Find the Pakistan Sweet Home nearest to you through the Bait-ul-Mal district office
Collect the admission form from the home or the district office
Submit the death certificate, the child's B-Form and the guardian's CNIC
Attend the admission interview with the child and the guardian
Complete the medical examination the home requires before admission
disclaimer: Admission depends on places being available at the home nearest you, and homes do not yet operate in every district. Confirm capacity at the Bait-ul-Mal district office before travelling.

name: Himmat Card - quarterly stipend for persons with disabilities
name_ur: ہمت کارڈ - معذور افراد کے لیے سہ ماہی وظیفہ
provider: Social Welfare & Bait-ul-Mal Department, Government of Punjab
target_group: Punjab-domicile persons with disabilities who are unable to earn a living
summary_en: A quarterly cash stipend for persons with disabilities in Punjab who cannot work, delivered on a bank card that can be used at any ATM or authorised retailer. It is paid to the individual rather than to a household, which makes it one of the few assistance payments a disabled adult receives in their own right.
summary_ur: پنجاب میں ان معذور افراد کے لیے سہ ماہی نقد وظیفہ جو کام کرنے کے قابل نہیں، جو ایک بینک کارڈ پر دیا جاتا ہے اور کسی بھی اے ٹی ایم یا مجاز دکان پر استعمال ہو سکتا ہے۔ یہ گھرانے کے بجائے فرد کو ادا کیا جاتا ہے، اس لیے یہ ان چند ادائیگیوں میں سے ہے جو ایک معذور بالغ اپنے حق میں وصول کرتا ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: A disability certificate issued by the district assessment board is the document that decides this application - a CNIC marked with the disability logo is normally required. The programme targets people whose disability prevents them from earning, so a person in regular employment is generally outside it even with a valid certificate. Registration with the Punjab Special Education or Social Welfare department is expected.

required_documents: Disability certificate from the district assessment board
CNIC bearing the disability logo
Punjab domicile certificate
Recent photographs
Proof of household income or an affidavit of financial condition
application_steps: Obtain a disability certificate from the district assessment board if you do not already hold one
Have the disability logo added to your CNIC at a NADRA centre
Register at the district Social Welfare office or through the Himmat Card portal
Submit the certificate, CNIC and domicile with the application
Collect the Himmat Card once approved, and draw the quarterly payment from any ATM or authorised retailer
source_title: Government of Punjab - Himmat Card programme
disclaimer: Enrolment is capped by the budget allocated each year, so a valid disability certificate does not by itself guarantee a card. Confirm whether registration is currently open at your district Social Welfare office.

name: Zakat Guzara Allowance - monthly subsistence support
name_ur: زکوٰۃ گزارہ الاؤنس - ماہانہ گزر بسر کی معاونت
provider: Provincial Zakat & Ushr Councils, through Local Zakat Committees
target_group: Deserving households with no reliable means of subsistence
summary_en: A modest monthly subsistence allowance paid from the Zakat fund through Local Zakat Committees, which are the neighbourhood-level bodies that identify recipients. Because assessment happens locally rather than through a national database, the practical route in is your union council's Local Zakat Committee rather than any online portal.
summary_ur: زکوٰۃ فنڈ سے مقامی زکوٰۃ کمیٹیوں کے ذریعے دیا جانے والا معمولی ماہانہ گزارہ الاؤنس، اور یہی کمیٹیاں محلے کی سطح پر مستحقین کی نشاندہی کرتی ہیں۔ چونکہ جانچ قومی ڈیٹابیس کے بجائے مقامی سطح پر ہوتی ہے، اس لیے عملی راستہ کسی آن لائن پورٹل کے بجائے آپ کی یونین کونسل کی مقامی زکوٰۃ کمیٹی ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Zakat is a religious fund and its disbursement is restricted to Muslims who qualify as mustahiq under the Zakat & Ushr Ordinance. This screening does not ask about religion and never will, so that condition cannot appear in the result - it is stated here instead. Widows, orphans, persons with disabilities and the chronically ill are given preference by Local Zakat Committees. Non-Muslim applicants in similar need should look at Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal, which is funded from general revenue and carries no such restriction.

required_documents: CNIC of the applicant
Affidavit of financial condition, or an income certificate
Death certificate of the spouse, for a widow's application
Disability certificate, if applying on that basis
Verification by two members of the Local Zakat Committee
application_steps: Find the Local Zakat Committee for your union council - ask at the union council office
Apply to the committee with your CNIC and a statement of your circumstances
Provide the affidavit or income certificate the committee asks for
Attend the committee's assessment and verification
Collect the monthly allowance through the bank or committee arrangement once you are listed
source_title: Punjab Zakat & Ushr Department - Guzara Allowance
disclaimer: Zakat is administered separately by each province, so the allowance amount, the application route and the assessment rules differ between Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. The official link is Punjab's; find your own province's Zakat & Ushr department if you live elsewhere. Disbursement depends on the funds collected locally.

name: Sehat Sahulat Programme - free hospital treatment card
name_ur: صحت سہولت پروگرام - مفت ہسپتال علاج کارڈ
provider: Ministry of National Health Services, and the provincial health departments
target_group: Low-income families needing cover for hospital treatment they could not otherwise afford
summary_en: Health cover rather than cash: a family entitlement that pays for inpatient hospital treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals, with no payment at the counter. It covers the expensive things - surgery, cardiac care, cancer treatment, childbirth complications - which are what usually pushes a household into debt.
summary_ur: نقد رقم کے بجائے صحت کی کوریج: ایک خاندانی سہولت جو منظور شدہ سرکاری اور نجی ہسپتالوں میں داخل مریض کے علاج کا خرچ ادا کرتی ہے، کاؤنٹر پر کچھ ادا کیے بغیر۔ یہ مہنگے علاج کا احاطہ کرتی ہے - سرجری، دل کا علاج، کینسر کا علاج، زچگی کی پیچیدگیاں - یعنی وہی چیزیں جو عموماً گھرانے کو قرض میں دھکیل دیتی ہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Coverage is a family entitlement tied to the head of the household's CNIC, so one enrolment covers the household rather than the individual applying. How the programme is targeted differs sharply by province and has been revised more than once - some provinces have run it universally, others restrict it to households below a poverty threshold. Check which rule your province currently applies. Only inpatient treatment at empanelled hospitals is covered; outpatient visits and medicines collected from a pharmacy generally are not.

required_documents: CNIC of the head of the household
B-Form for children included in the family entitlement
Proof of residence in the district, where the province requires it
application_steps: Check your entitlement by sending your CNIC to 8500, or at any empanelled hospital's Sehat Sahulat desk
Confirm which targeting rule your province currently applies
Visit the Sehat Sahulat counter at an empanelled hospital when treatment is needed
Present the CNIC of the head of the household for verification
Receive inpatient treatment without paying at the counter, up to the cover limit
disclaimer: Which households are covered has changed repeatedly and differs by province - this is the record most likely to be out of date for your area. Verify your entitlement on 8500 or at an empanelled hospital before relying on it. The cover limit applies per family per year.

name: Interest-free loan for a small business or trade
name_ur: چھوٹے کاروبار یا ہنر کے لیے بلا سود قرض
provider: Pakistan Poverty Alleviation Fund and partner microfinance organisations
target_group: Adults from low-income households wanting to start or expand a small enterprise
summary_en: A small interest-free loan, repaid in modest monthly instalments, for people who want to start or grow a trade rather than receive a stipend. Loans are delivered through partner organisations working at community level and are usually backed by a personal guarantor instead of collateral, which is what makes them reachable for households with no assets to pledge.
summary_ur: ایک چھوٹا بلا سود قرض، جو معمولی ماہانہ اقساط میں واپس کیا جاتا ہے، ان لوگوں کے لیے جو وظیفہ لینے کے بجائے کوئی کاروبار شروع یا بڑھانا چاہتے ہیں۔ یہ قرض کمیونٹی کی سطح پر کام کرنے والی شراکت دار تنظیموں کے ذریعے دیا جاتا ہے اور عام طور پر ضمانتی جائیداد کے بجائے ذاتی ضامن پر دیا جاتا ہے، اسی لیے یہ ان گھرانوں کی پہنچ میں ہے جن کے پاس رہن رکھنے کو کچھ نہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: This is a loan and must be repaid, which makes it different in kind from every other record in this category - do not take it on unless the monthly instalment is genuinely affordable. A personal guarantor is normally required in place of collateral. A workable business idea or an existing trade counts for more than paperwork, and partner organisations give particular attention to women borrowers and to households with no other earner.

required_documents: CNIC of the applicant
CNIC of the guarantor
A simple written plan for the business or trade
Proof of residence
Documentation of an existing business, if you already run one
application_steps: Find the partner microfinance organisation operating in your district
Attend the introductory session the organisation runs for new borrowers
Prepare a simple plan for what the loan will buy and how it will be repaid
Arrange a guarantor who holds a valid CNIC
Submit the application with both CNICs and the plan
Receive the loan after approval and begin the monthly repayments on schedule
source_title: Pakistan Poverty Alleviation Fund - interest-free loan programme
disclaimer: This is a loan, not a grant, and it carries a repayment obligation. Loan sizes, the guarantor requirement and district coverage differ between partner organisations. Confirm the terms with the organisation operating in your district before committing.

name: EOBI Old-Age Pension - pension for former private-sector workers
name_ur: ای او بی آئی بڑھاپا پنشن - سابق نجی شعبے کے ملازمین کے لیے پنشن
target_group: Older people who worked in registered private-sector employment for at least fifteen years
summary_en: A monthly pension for people who spent their working life in registered private-sector employment - factories, mills, registered companies - where the employer paid EOBI contributions on their behalf. Unlike everything else in this category it is not means-tested: it is an earned entitlement based on your contribution record, so income is irrelevant and the contribution history is everything.
summary_ur: ان لوگوں کے لیے ماہانہ پنشن جنہوں نے اپنی ملازمت کی زندگی رجسٹرڈ نجی اداروں - کارخانوں، ملوں، رجسٹرڈ کمپنیوں - میں گزاری، جہاں آجر نے ان کی طرف سے ای او بی آئی کے چندے ادا کیے۔ اس زمرے کی باقی تمام چیزوں کے برعکس یہ ضرورت کی بنیاد پر نہیں: یہ آپ کے چندے کے ریکارڈ پر مبنی کمایا ہوا حق ہے، اس لیے آمدنی غیر متعلق ہے اور سب کچھ چندے کی تاریخ پر منحصر ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: The pension age is 60 for men and 55 for women; this record uses 55 so that neither is wrongly screened out, but check which applies to you. At least fifteen years of insured employment with EOBI contributions paid by your employer is the real gate, and it is worth verifying early - many workers discover late that an employer never registered them. A widow or widower of an insured person may claim a survivor's pension under separate rules.

required_documents: CNIC of the claimant
EOBI registration number or card
Service and contribution record from your former employer
Proof of date of birth
Bank account details for the pension transfer
Death certificate and marriage proof, for a survivor's pension
application_steps: Check your contribution record on the EOBI portal or at a regional office - do this well before you reach pension age
Ask your former employer to correct the record if contributions are missing
Collect the pension claim form from your regional EOBI office
Submit it with your CNIC, EOBI number and service record
Provide the bank account the pension will be paid into
Follow up at the regional office until the first payment is released
disclaimer: This is a contributory entitlement, not assistance for the poor - it depends entirely on whether an employer registered you and paid contributions. Only registered private-sector employment counts; government service, agricultural work and informal daily-wage work do not. Verify your contribution record with EOBI before assuming eligibility.
